capabilities: Reorder files and folders with drag-and-drop dialog
Add numeric prefixes to file names
Update references when reordering renames files
Clear prefixes to restore default ordering
Configure prefix length, delimiter and starting index
problem: Obsidian's file explorer only sorts by default rules, with no way to impose a custom, persistent order on files within a folder.
summary: File-ordering plugin that uses numeric filename prefixes to define custom order and offers a drag-and-drop dialog to reorder files in a folder.
